## EPIGLOTTITIS
Maintaining the airway is the key to management. Call ENT service and ask them
to see the patient immediately. Blood cultures and epiglottal cultures (in
intubated patients) should be used to direct antimicrobial therapy. Empirical
therapy should be initiated prior to results of cultures as infection is life
threatening and cover for likely pathogens (Moraxella catarrhalis, penicillin
resistant S. pneumonia, beta-hemolytic streptococci and possibly Staph. aureus)
## Inpatient

## Empiric Treatment
Preferred:
[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h ($) [M] <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q 12h ($) [R]](orz-set-abx-cetriax-2g-q24h-vanco-15mg-kg-q12h)
for 7 days
Alternative:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](orzid2-gmenu-abx-beta-lactam-allergy-assesment)
[Levofloxacin 500 mg IV q24h ($) [R,DI] <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]](orz-set-abx-levoflox-500mg-qd-vanco-15mg-kg-q12)
for 7 days
